messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up TiltBank reporting p99 embeddings/semantic-search spikes since 03:10 UTC, started after the canary. Topline: 40% p99 increase, customer flagged SLA risk. @Alex Torres can you take initial triage? :warning:
ops-bot: deploy/canary completed by ci-deploy at 03:05 UTC, tag: release/v2.8.1-canary
Alex Torres: looking. can we get latest traces? @Jin Park grabbing runtime logs + tailing kv-cache metrics
Jin Park: pulling logs now. seeing increased queue depth on pool-dedicated-4, batching up to 64 on some requests. suspect batching policy + long sequences. grabbing stack traces.
Britt Coleman: customer says fallbacks not happening; they saw 503s. I told them we're investigating and will update in 30m.
Alex Torres: plan: (1) scale pool-dedicated-4 +2 nodes (2) pin canary to model-quant-v1 for TiltBank traffic (3) temp reduce max_batch_size to 32. Who can PL the pin? @Maya
Maya Chen: I can pin routing rule. will do a quick config change and post commands.
Maya Chen: (command)
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"customer":"tiltbank","variant":"model-quant-v1","sticky":true}'
```
Maya Chen: applied. verifying.
Jin Park: logs show immediate drop in queue depth after pin, but tail latency still high for ~3 of 20 hosts. suspect warmup/kv-cache cold. Recommend warmup calls + restart one problematic shard.
Alex Torres: I'll schedule a rolling restart on pool-dedicated-4-host-17 now. timing ~5m.
ops-bot: restart job queued: host-17, job id 67321, initiated by Alex Torres
Alex Torres: restart done. post-restart p50/p95 look good, p99 down 25% from peak. Need a CR to make batching-policy more conservative for high-token sequences.
Maya Chen: I've created a temporary runbook in /confluence/tiltbank-hotfix with steps and owners. Link: https://confluence.internal/tiltbank-hotfix
Britt Coleman: customer updated, says errors dropped but wants ETA on permanent fix and rollback risk. asking for SLA commitment.
Alex Torres: short-term ETA: we keep pinned variant + reduced batch size for 24h, monitor. Permanent fix: follow-up PR to adjust batching heuristic + add kv-cache prewarm (owner Jin), target end of day tomorrow.
Jin Park: I'll own PR and prewarm patch. PR ping when ready — need a quick review from @Maya and @Alex.
Maya Chen: will review. quick CR window 2h.
Britt Coleman: I'll tell TiltBank we're committing to 24h guarded config and EOD patch timeline. thanks team.
Alex Torres: any blockers? customer on standby if we need to reroute. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: no blockers. logging action items:
- Alex Torres: scale + restarts, monitor (done)
- Maya Chen: pin routing rule + docs (done)
- Jin Park: PR + kv prewarm (owner, due EOD tomorrow)
- Britt Coleman: customer comms (owner)
Alex Torres: tossing a code-review ping: https://git.internal/r/redwood/platform/+/12345 :eyes:
Jin Park: pinged. will push PR by 13:30 UTC.
Britt Coleman: excellent. I'll close the loop with TiltBank in 30m.
Maya Chen: thanks all. I'll keep thread updated if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
